open_issues.description: Legacy timing/window/gap/estimate properties are not the configured V2 owners. Production preflight must resolve the declared controller and parameter owner; mere property presence is insufficient.

Legacy scalar timing setters only compare signs; they do not explicitly reject NaN/+Inf. This is a source-confirmed validation gap, not a reproduced numerical failure or proof a specific XML parser admits nonfinite values.

Legacy ABuild and AReset still propagate false on some internal failures. This contradicts the approved always-true lifecycle contract. Preserve stop/diagnostics and scheduling when correcting it; do not mechanically replace false without a runtime negative control.

limitations: Source references identify real code, not runtime evidence; no numerical tests run for this documentation change.
Original source_inventory.json and control review retain their snapshots.
